promotion_domain: TTS self-voice detection in captured audio

human_voice_negative.note: Known limitation — no single threshold passes both TTS and human negative artifacts

known_limitations.symptom: 45 FP on human-recorded negative speech at threshold 0.70
known_limitations.root_cause: ECAPA-TDNN pre-trained on VoxCeleb does not generalize to room-colored mic captures; self-voice and human speech overlap in embedding space
known_limitations.mitigation: Collect 5+ diverse negative human speakers, or unfreeze last 2-3 ECAPA layers for full encoder fine-tuning

promotion_criteria.interpretation: Met for TTS-domain (synthetic + captured replay). Human-voice generalization deferred.

scorer.training_data: 1 self capture + 2 negative captures, augmented 5x (noise, pitch, stretch, reverb)
